basis: 19/19 terminal identity dispositions against active catalog v0.55.2

impacts.detail: Seven exact IDs contain identity-field mismatches; two identities are confirmed; eight need provenance reinforcement; two Alpine IDs remain deferred. Do not rewrite v0.55.2.
No pointer change in this work unit. A future pointer update must occur only after patch validation and downstream compatibility gates pass.
Preserve old IDs historically. Corrected identities require new deterministic IDs; mismatched IDs must not be reused.
Seven mismatched IDs should be excluded by the future patch. No Decision Engine change is authorized in this work unit.
Any mapping to a mismatched exact ID must be terminated or rebound only to a newly verified exact identity. No evidence may be copied by alias.
Equipment semantic risk is separate from catalog identity. Existing evidence remains attached to its historical ID; no transfer to successor IDs is allowed without a new exact applicability review.
Re-run exact-ID and field-path compatibility. Content regeneration is required only where an identity field used by the layer changes.
Remove quarantined exact memberships and add successors only after owner-scope and source compatibility are re-established.
Family media may remain; exact-ID media queues and coverage fixtures must be checked for mismatched IDs.
Egea and Alpine records require explicit validity/lifecycle semantics. Price presence does not prove exact identity or current lifecycle.
No alias or migration is produced now. Before activation, inventory references to affected IDs and design an explicit audited migration/supersession policy.
Future import must be additive/immutable and idempotent; it must not update identity fields of historical IDs in place.
Release fingerprints, generated catalog module, counts and downstream release-bound tests must move together.
No route, UI or consumer behavior change is required to publish this audit.
